sql_af1_31_6 = """
SELECT T1.MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,
       6 AS SECTOR,
       '31' AS C_CAGENTE,
       T1.C_CUENTA,
       'H' AS C_ENTRADA,

       '0037' AS PROC

   OR (T1.SECTOR=6 AND T1.C_CAGENTE='31' AND T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.1' AND FUENTE='CI')
GROUP BY T1.MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, T1.C_CUENTA,
